observations: The analyzer verifies only listed inventory members, then reads manifest and metrics without requiring inventory membership.
Consumed JSON is reread after initial hashing and parsed permissively, so its exact parsed bytes may not be the verified bytes.
Analysis output can be created inside the retained run directory.
hypothesis: Require every consumed JSON receipt in the inventory and verify the exact parsed bytes; reject duplicate/nonfinite JSON and require output outside the source run.
scope: JSON-only constructed evidence fixtures plus the existing tiny CPU engineering tests; no pilot execution, GPU run, training campaign or protected data.
retention: Keep the original failed test output, source head and all historical scientific limitations; passing tests cannot complete any empirical study.
